title: Patents & Structure
subtitle: Structure & Innovation
overview: 围绕取料、涂抹与单手操作展开的结构创新，从产品概念、使用交互到工程协同与知识产权转化。
overviewEn: Structural packaging innovations focused on dispensing, application and one-handed use. My contributions span product concepts, interaction and structural design, collaboration with engineering, and the development of intellectual property.

sections.heading: 刮刀式涂抹化妆品容器
sections.body: CN224069925U · 共同发明人 · 产品与结构设计 · 已授权。通过瓶口内塞刮除涂抹杆多余料体，只在两侧保留用料，使取料更均匀，并帮助瓶口保持清洁。
sections.bodyEn: CN224069925U · Co-inventor · Product and Structural Design · Granted. A wiper at the bottle neck removes excess formula from the applicator wand while retaining product on both sides, supporting more even dispensing and a cleaner opening.

sections.heading: 旋转挤出式化妆容器
sections.body: CN223943970U · 产品概念与结构设计 · 已授权。通过旋转底座推动内部结构持续上升，减少口红式包装中的残留料体。
sections.bodyEn: CN223943970U · Product Concept and Structural Design · Granted. Turning the base raises the internal mechanism progressively, helping reduce residual formula in stick packaging.

sections.heading: 可单手操作的化妆品容器
sections.body: CN122271664A · 原创概念与交互设计 · 专利申请。围绕单手启闭与取用路径优化容器交互，使产品在移动和日常场景中更易操作。
sections.bodyEn: CN122271664A · Original Concept and Interaction Design · Patent Application. The interaction was designed around one-handed opening, closing and access, improving use in everyday and on-the-go contexts.

sections.heading: GLS-355 Refillable Lipstick
sections.body: 可替换内胆结构 · 产品与结构设计。通过无胶互锁、稳定杯体与底部驱动式替换系统，使口红组件更易拆解、替换与分类回收，并兼顾使用稳定性。
sections.bodyEn: Refillable structure · Product and Structural Design. A glue-free interlock, stable cup and base-driven replacement system make the lipstick components easier to disassemble, replace and sort for recycling while maintaining stability in use.
